dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: Tea has four charms — color, infused leaves, aroma, and texture. Everyone has their preferences.

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: If it's them you're looking to purchase, then consider trying at Boss Yip's place.

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: His teas have a strong aroma and taste that have captured the hearts of countless enthusiasts. Superb choices indeed.
